title: Anonymous
description: This plugin makes every player anonymous
body:
# UnknownSMP

> **⚠️ REQUIREMENTS**
> - **[ProtocolLib](https://modrinth.com/plugin/protocollib)** (Required)
> - **[NickAPI](https://modrinth.com/plugin/nickapi)** (Required)
> - **[TAB](https://modrinth.com/plugin/tab)** (Highly Recommended for full tablist masking)

**UnknownSMP** is a Paper/Spigot plugin designed to recreate the core mechanics of Project Unknown, enforcing absolute anonymity among all players.

## 🌟 Features
- **Total Anonymity:** All players join with the same masked name (e.g., "Player") and skin (e.g., "Steve").
- **Death-Ban Mechanic:** If a player is killed with an item renamed to their *real* Minecraft username, their identity is discovered and they are banned.
- **Chat & Tab Completion Masking:** Custom chat formatting and hidden names in command tab-completion prevent accidental identity leaks.
- **Death Message Scrubbing:** Real names are dynamically replaced in all death broadcast messages.
- **Command Blocking:** Prevent players from using commands (like `/msg`) that could expose identities.

## ⚙️ Configuration
The plugin offers an easy-to-use `config.yml` where you can toggle join/quit messages, set the anonymous name, configure death-ban settings, and manage blocked commands.

*Perfect for hardcore social deduction SMPs where keeping your true identity hidden is the only way to survive!*
